commit.message:
App Builder: live preview, Chronos kit, design editor, storage and security fixes

Live preview
- Compile the generated workspace in a sandboxed iframe (Sucrase + esm.sh) and
  render it while files stream in; planned files show placeholders.
- Generation is a server-side run the page re-attaches to after a reload;
  pages generate in parallel after shared files; App.tsx routes and the kit
  sidebar are wired as pages land; JSX in .ts data files is saved as .tsx.
- Preview toolbar: routes, device widths, light/dark, console with
  "Fix with AI" on compile/render errors.

Chronos kit and 3D icons
- Ship a ported Chronos UI kit (AppShell, PageHeader, Panel, KpiTile,
  DataTable, Chart, Mark, ...) in every generated app; prompts compose it, so
  pages are much shorter. Kit is hardened against bad props, sections are
  error-bounded, components accept className (tailwind-merge), and apps with
  an older kit are upgraded when opened.
- Unified 3D icon library (~920 icons from the Wayam library, Manthan, Setu,
  WayamEye, Chronos) with a manifest; prompts get relevant icons only; used
  icons are bundled into downloads and pushes.

Design tab
- Visual edit: click to select (kit components map to the page that used
  them), edit text in place, typography/fill/border/spacing controls, 3D icon
  picker, parent select, undo/redo, Ask AI per element.
- Theme editor: token-level presets, brand colour, surfaces, default mode,
  status and chart colours, fonts and radius, written to src/design.css and
  design.json for both the preview and the shipped app.

Apps and storage
- Every App Builder file is mirrored to MongoDB and restored when the disk
  copy is gone; "Your apps" list with open/delete; download as zip.

Responsive layout, charts, dropdowns and naming
- Kit sizes itself: KPI figures scale to the tile width and value length,
  labels wrap, KpiGrid/Grid choose their own column count, page titles are
  fluid; prompts require these layouts.
- Charts ported from Wayam UI: line/area/bar/combo, donut with centre total,
  sparkline, gauge, progress ring and bars, funnel, bullet, chart card.
- Custom keyboard-accessible dropdown in the kit; styled dropdowns in the
  Design tab.
- Plain tool names (App Studio, Code Workspace, Product Specs, Sprint
  Health, CI Health, ...) and plain names for generated apps.
- Planner writes per-page blueprints; failed builds are repaired once
  automatically.

Security and correctness
- Fix path traversal in chain analysis, .git access through workspace files,
  PAT left in clone config, token written to App Builder .git/config, push
  rejections reported as success, empty-path workspace wipe, login lockout
  bypass via X-Forwarded-For, SSRF error echo, and several wrong status codes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Prepare for production deploy: sign-in only, safer defaults, leaner image

- Sign-up disabled by default; a seed account is created from configuration.
- List settings accept JSON or commas; localhost origins dropped in production.
- API docs hidden in production; database-only /readyz probe; sign-in rate limit.
- Process-wide browser cap, request time limit, socket origin check.
- Image: init process, no duplicated browser layer, proxy-aware server.
- Pages load on demand; marks on empty states, verdicts, stages and KPI tiles.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
